name: almost_surjective_of_insert_index
statement:
lemma almost_surjective_of_insert_index (j : Fin (SC.n+1)) (a : Fin (SC.n+1)) (h : a ≠ j)
    : ∃ k : Fin (n1 + 1) , a = @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j k

name: ccc_fun_is_insert_index
statement:
lemma ccc_fun_is_insert_index I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) :
    ∃ j, ccc_fun SC I = @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j

name: ccc_fun_strict_mono
statement:
lemma ccc_fun_strict_mono {m} I (hs : simplex SC m I) :
    StrictMono (ccc_fun SC I)

name: child_simplex_char
statement:
lemma child_simplex_char (I : Fin (n1 +1) → SC.G) J {hs : simplex SC SC.n J}
    : is_face SC I J ↔ ∃ i, I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i J

name: delete_vertex_ccc_fun_match
statement:
lemma delete_vertex_ccc_fun_match J (hs : simplex SC SC.n J) j1 j2
    ( h1 : ccc_fun SC (@delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j1 J) = @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j2)
    : (j1 = 0 → j2 = Fin.last SC.n) ∧ (j1 ≠ 0 → j1 = j2)

name: delete_vertex_inj
statement:
lemma delete_vertex_inj J {hs : simplex SC SC.n J} i1 i2
    (h1 : @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i1 J = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i2 J ) : i1 = i2

name: delete_vertex_is_face
statement:
lemma delete_vertex_is_face J {hs : simplex SC SC.n J} i :
    is_face SC (@delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i J) J

name: delete_vertex_simplex
statement:
lemma delete_vertex_simplex J {hs : simplex SC SC.n J} i :
    simplex SC n1 (@delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i J)

name: insert_index_inj
statement: lemma insert_index_inj j : Function.Injective (@insert_index SC n1 hn1 j)

name: insert_index_ne
statement: lemma insert_index_ne j a : @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j a ≠ j

name: insert_index_strict_mono
statement: lemma insert_index_strict_mono j : StrictMono (@insert_index SC n1 hn1 j)

name: insert_vertex
statement:
lemma insert_vertex I (v : SC.G) j :
    ∃ J, I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J ∧ J j = v

name: is_id_of_strict_mono
statement:
lemma is_id_of_strict_mono (m: ℕ ) (f : Fin m → Fin m) (hsm : StrictMono f)
    : ∀ k, f k = k

name: is_insert_index_of_strict_mono
statement:
lemma is_insert_index_of_strict_mono f (hsm : StrictMono f)
    : ∃ j, f = @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j

name: last_of_simplex
statement:
lemma last_of_simplex {m: ℕ} I (hs : simplex SC m I) j :
    (I (Fin.last m) j).1 ≤ (I 0 j).1 + 1

name: le_add_one_of_simplex
statement:
lemma le_add_one_of_simplex {m: ℕ} I (hs : simplex SC m I) (i1 i2 : Fin (m+1)) j :
    (I i1 j).1 ≤ (I i2 j).1 + 1

name: monotone_1_of_simplex
statement:
lemma monotone_1_of_simplex {m:ℕ } (I : Fin (m+1)→ SC.G) (hs : simplex SC m I) (i1 i2 : Fin (m+1))
    (h1 : i1 ≤ i2) : ∀ j, I i1 j ≤ I i2 j

name: monotone_2_of_simplex
statement:
lemma monotone_2_of_simplex {m:ℕ } (I : Fin (m+1)→ SC.G) (hs : simplex SC m I) (i1 i2 : Fin (m+1)) :
    i1 ≤ i2 ↔ ∀ j, I i1 j ≤ I i2 j

name: one_of_ABCD
statement:
lemma one_of_ABCD (I : Fin (n1 +1) → SC.G) :
    case_A SC I ∨ case_B SC I ∨ case_C SC I ∨ case_D SC I

name: p_ne_zero_of_cube
statement: lemma p_ne_zero_of_cube {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n}: Fin.last SC.p ≠ 0

name: parent_injective
statement:
lemma parent_injective I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) J j
    (h1 : I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J) (h2 : J j ∉ Set.range I)
    : Function.Injective J

name: parent_simplex_case_AC
statement:
lemma parent_simplex_case_AC I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) J j (hj : j = Fin.last SC.n)
    (h1 : I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J) (h2 : J j ≠ I (Fin.last n1))
    (h3 : ∀ k, I (Fin.last n1) k ≤ J j k ∧ (J j k).1 ≤ (I 0 k).1 + 1) : is_face SC I J

name: parent_simplex_case_BC
statement:
lemma parent_simplex_case_BC I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) J
    (h1 : I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 0 J) (h2 : J 0 ≠ I 0)
    (h3 : ∀ k, J 0 k ≤ I 0 k ∧ (I (Fin.last n1) k).1 ≤ (J 0 k).1 + 1) : is_face SC I J

name: parent_simplex_case_D
statement:
lemma parent_simplex_case_D I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) J j i
    (hij : i.1 + 1 = j.1 ) (h1 : I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J) (h2 : J j ∉ Set.range I)
    (h3 : ∀ k, I i k ≤ J j k ∧ J j k ≤ I (i+1) k) : is_face SC I J

name: same_delete_index_eq_iff
statement:
lemma same_delete_index_eq_iff J1 J2 j
    (h1 : @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J1 = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 j J2)
    : J1 = J2 ↔ J1 j = J2 j

name: surround_index
statement:
lemma surround_index (j : Fin (SC.n + 1)) (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) (hij : i.1 + 1 = j.1 )
    (hj1 : j ≠ Fin.last SC.n): ((@insert_index SC n1 hn1 j i).1 + 1 = j.1
    ∧ j.1 + 1 = @insert_index SC n1 hn1 j (i+1))

name: unique_const_ABC
statement:
lemma unique_const_ABC {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} I (hs : simplex SC n1 I) k1 q1
    (h1 : ∀ i, I i k1 = q1): ∀ k2, k1 ≠ k2 → I 0 k2 ≠ I (Fin.last n1) k2

name: zero_ne_last
statement: lemma zero_ne_last {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} : 0 ≠ Fin.last SC.n

name: char_complete_face
statement:
lemma char_complete_face {SC n1 hn1} I J (hs : simplex SC SC.n J) :
    complete_simplex SC n1 I ∧ is_face SC I J
    ↔ ∃ i, I = @delete_vertex SC n1 hn1 i J
    ∧ ∀ (c:ℕ ), c ≤ n1 → ∃ i2, i2 ≠ i ∧ SC.RL (J i2) = c

name: child_map_applied
statement:
lemma child_map_applied [NeZero SC.n] {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} (v : Fin n1 → Fin (SC.p + 1))
    : ∀ (i : Fin n1), child_map SC v (Fin.ofNat _ i.1) = v i

name: child_map_inj
statement: lemma child_map_inj {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n }: Function.Injective (@child_map SC n1)

name: child_map_last
statement:
lemma child_map_last (v : Fin n1 → Fin (SC.p +1 ))
    : ∀ j, j.1 + 1 = SC.n → child_map SC v j = SC.p

name: child_map_surj_on
statement:
lemma child_map_surj_on {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} w
    (h1 : ∀ j, j.1 + 1 = SC.n → w j = SC.p)
    : ∃ v, @child_map SC n1 v = w

name: complete_child_uniq
statement:
lemma complete_child_uniq {SC n1} {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} J (hcs : complete_simplex SC SC.n J) :
    ∃! (I : Fin (n1+1) → SC.G), complete_simplex SC n1 I ∧ is_face SC I J

name: complete_simplex_iff
statement:
lemma complete_simplex_iff {SC} m I(hs : simplex SC m I) :
    complete_simplex SC m I ↔ ∀ c, c≤m → ∃ i, SC.RL (I i) = c

name: handshake_1
statement:
lemma handshake_1 (r : A → B → Prop)
    (c1 c2 c3: A → Prop) (d1 d2: B → Prop)
    (h1 : ∀ b, d1 b → ∃! a, c2 a ∧ r a b)
    (h2 : ∀ b, d2 b → ¬ d1 b → Even (Finset.card { a | c2 a ∧ r a b}))
    (h3 : ∀ a, c3 a → Finset.card { b | r a b} ∈ {c | c = 1 ∨ c = 2})
    (h5 : ∀ a, c1 a ↔ (∃! b, r a b) ∧ c2 a)
    (h6 : ∀ a, c2 a → c3 a) (h7 : ∀ b, ∀ a, r a b → d2 b)
    : Odd (Finset.card {a : A | c1 a}) → Odd (Finset.card {b : B | d1 b})

name: handshake_2
statement:
lemma handshake_2 (r : A → B → Prop)
    (c : A → Prop) (d : B → Prop)
    (h1 : ∀ a, c a ↔ Odd (Finset.card {b | r a b}))
    (h2 : ∀ b, d b ↔ Odd (Finset.card {a | r a b})) :
    Odd (Finset.card {a | c a}) → Odd (Finset.card {b | d b})

name: handshake_3
statement:
lemma handshake_3 (r : A → B → Prop) (c : A → Prop)
    (h1 : ∀ a, c a ↔ Odd (Finset.card {b | r a b}))
    : Odd (Finset.card {a | c a}) ↔ Odd (∑ a, Finset.card {b | r a b})

name: incomplete_childs
statement:
lemma incomplete_childs {SC n1} {hn1 : n1 + 1 = SC.n} J (hs : simplex SC SC.n J)
    (hnc : ¬ complete_simplex SC SC.n J):
    Even (Finset.card { I : Fin (n1 + 1) → SC.G | complete_simplex SC n1 I ∧ is_face SC I J})

name: induction_start
statement:
lemma induction_start (SC : SpernerCube) (h0 : 0 = SC.n)
    : Odd (Finset.card { I | complete_simplex SC SC.n I})

name: rl_inj_of_complete
statement:
lemma rl_inj_of_complete {SC} m I (hcs : complete_simplex SC m I):
    ∀ i1 i2, SC.RL (I i1) = SC.RL (I i2) → i1 = i2

name: dist_discrete_map
statement:
lemma dist_discrete_map p (ppos: 0 < p) (v1 v2 : Fin n → Fin (p+1))
    (h1 : ∀ k, (v1 k).1 ≤ (v2 k).1 + 1 ∧ (v2 k).1 ≤ (v1 k).1 + 1) :
    dist (discrete_map p v1) (discrete_map p v2) ≤ 1 / p

name: reduced_label_props_1
statement:
lemma reduced_label_props_1 (f : @unit_cube n → @unit_cube n) (x : @unit_cube n)
    : @rl_point n f x ≤ n ∧ ∀ k,
    (@rl_point n f x = k.1 → (f x).1 k < x.1 k ∨ x.1 k = 1)
    ∧ ((f x).1 k < x.1 k ∨ x.1 k = 1 → @rl_point n f x ≤ k.1)

name: reduced_label_props_2
statement:
lemma reduced_label_props_2 (f : @unit_cube n → @unit_cube n) (x : @unit_cube n)
    : @rl_point n f x ≤ n ∧
    ∀ k, (x.1 k = 0 → @rl_point n f x ≠ k.1) ∧ (x.1 k = 1 → @rl_point n f x ≤ k.1)

name: reduced_label_props_3
statement:
lemma reduced_label_props_3 (f : @unit_cube n → @unit_cube n) (x : @unit_cube n) (k : Fin n)
    : (@rl_point n f x = k → (f x).1 k ≤ x.1 k) ∧ (@rl_point n f x > k → (f x).1 k ≥ x.1 k)

name: homeo_of_finrank_eq
statement:
theorem homeo_of_finrank_eq {V W : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (hreq : Module.finrank ℝ V = Module.finrank ℝ W) :
    Nonempty (Metric.closedBall (0: V) 1 ≃ₜ Metric.closedBall (0: W) 1)

name: homeo_unit_ball
statement:
lemma homeo_unit_ball {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (s: Set V) (hcvx : Convex ℝ s) (hcmpct : IsCompact s)
    (hni : (interior s).Nonempty):
    Nonempty (s ≃ₜ Metric.closedBall (0: V) 1)

name: homeo_unit_cube_of_convex_compact
statement:
lemma homeo_unit_cube_of_convex_compact {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (s: Set V) (hcvx : Convex ℝ s) (hcmpct : IsCompact s) (hne : s.Nonempty)
    : ∃ k, Nonempty (s ≃ₜ Set.Icc (0 : Fin k → ℝ) 1)

name: unit_cube_homeo_unit_ball
statement:
lemma unit_cube_homeo_unit_ball {n}
    : Nonempty (Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1 ≃ₜ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1 )

name: caratheodory_1
statement:
lemma caratheodory_1 {V : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    (s : Set V) k (h1 : k = Module.finrank ℝ V) {x} (h2 : x ∈ convexHull ℝ s)
    : ∃ (z : Fin (k+1)→ V), ∃ a, Set.range z ⊆ s ∧ convex_comb x a z

name: mem_of_convex_comb
statement:
lemma mem_of_convex_comb {V : Type*} {k: ℕ} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
  (x : V) {a : Fin k → ℝ} {y: Fin k → V} (h0 : convex_comb x a y)
  s (h1 : Convex ℝ s) (h2 : ∀ i, y i ∈ s): x ∈ s

name: sub_ICC_of_convex_comb
statement:
lemma sub_ICC_of_convex_comb {V : Type*} {k: ℕ} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (x : V) {a : Fin k → ℝ} {y: Fin k → V} (h0 : convex_comb x a y)
    : a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1
